hero.eyebrow: Department of Agriculture · Kosgi Division · Narayanpet District
hero.title: 100 Farmers - 100 Innovative Agriculture Activities
hero.body: A flagship initiative to transform Kosgi Division into a model hub of innovative, sustainable, and income-oriented agriculture. Each selected farmer adopts one unique activity, creating live demonstration models across agriculture, horticulture, floriculture, livestock and fisheries, natural farming, and agri-business.
hero.imageAlt: Illustrated field rows representing Project K-100 demonstration farms

stats.label: Core programme areas from crops to value addition
Farmers expected to be inspired indirectly

about.title: Income-oriented agriculture with visible field models
about.body: The programme aligns with government priorities for doubling farmers' income, reducing cultivation cost, and promoting each farmer as an agri-entrepreneur.

cards.title: Vision alignment
cards.body: Project K-100 promotes high-value crops, crop diversification, integrated farming systems, stronger market linkages, value addition, efficient input use, and natural farming practices.

cards.title: Kosgi focus
cards.body: Kosgi Mandal is positioned as a strategic innovation zone where selected farmers can become visible model farmers with strong earning potential and replication value.

cards.title: Farmer as entrepreneur
cards.body: The programme recognizes the farmer as an investor, skilled professional, job creator, and producer contributing to food security.

cards.title: Telugu vision
cards.body: The programme carries the local aspiration: "100 మంది రైతులను లక్షాధికారులుగా తీర్చిదిద్దడం" - transforming 100 farmers into lakh-earning model farmers.

implementation.title: Selection
implementation.body: Select 100 farmers, one per activity, with village-wise distribution to improve coverage and demonstration value.

implementation.title: Training
implementation.body: Use support from the department, KVKs, and universities for direct farmer-oriented practical demonstrations.

implementation.title: Execution
implementation.body: Support field implementation through input support, NGO/CSR/individual partnerships, and line-department convergence.

implementation.title: Monitoring
implementation.body: Track progress regularly and document success stories so the models become practical learning centres.

outcomes.title: Direct outputs
outcomes.body: 100 demonstration models, stronger farmer visibility, diversified farming, and practical examples of income-oriented agriculture.

outcomes.title: Economic outcomes
outcomes.body: 30-100% income increase potential, employment generation, and stronger market-facing agricultural activity.

outcomes.title: Long-term transformation
outcomes.body: 100 success stories, inspiration for 1000+ farmers, and a stronger rural innovation cluster for Kosgi.

mela.title: Mega Kisan Mela
mela.body: The programme culminates in a public showcase bringing together all models, demonstrations, and recognition activities under one roof.

footerQuote: Great projects always begin with criticism, challenges, and resistance, but true progress is achieved through patience, consistency, and dedication.
